readerCopy.headline: Take the invitation seriously.
readerCopy.body:
Someone gives you a chance to present the work, take a larger role, or put your name forward. You may be noticed before you feel completely ready. The opening matters because another person can already see enough to give you somewhere to go next.

Jupiter sextile Sun responds to participation. Step through enough for people to see what you can actually do. You can decide later if you want the whole role. First, give the opportunity a real answer instead of waiting to feel like the most qualified person in the room.
